messages:
Maya: Quick sync — can we do a short synthesis of the top failure modes we've seen this quarter and make a small, owned action list? want to hand off to PMs by end of week.
Sam: +1. I can pull the postmortem list and frequency counts. will highlight repeats.
Alex: I have a WIP heatmap notebook for Q4 incidents, but it's noisy — need to collapse by root cause category.
Jordan: Oncall perspective: three of the last five Sev2s were cache eviction regressions when rolling kernel updates. Not sure if it's infra or model-serving config.
Rachel: From support tickets, time-to-detect for these spikes averages 24m. alert thresholds tuned too loose.
Sam: Plan: I’ll produce a short table: cause, count, median time-to-recover, last PM id. will add tags for "infrastructure", "serving", "config", "third-party". target: draft in 24h.
Maya: Good. Call out recurring owners (who's responsible for remediation) and propose realistic timelines (2w / 1mo / 3mo).
Alex: For the kernel/eviction cluster I can own an infra runbook and pinned rollout policy. estimate 3 weeks to validate on staging + canary.
Jordan: I’ll add a playbook snippet for immediate mitigations (force fallback to stable kernel, increase cache headroom).
Rachel: I'll scope alerting changes: lower threshold + add a synthetic probe for cache pressure. 1 week estimate.
oncall-bot: New PM created: PM-2027-045 (title: "Q4 failure-mode synthesis"). Creator: Sam.
Sam: Linking quick list of postmortems: PM-2027-038, PM-2027-041, PM-2027-043 — these cover the eviction spikes and two unrelated memory leaks.
Maya: For memory leaks: are they library-level (model runtime) or app-level? we should decide fix vs mitigation.
Alex: Memory leaks look tied to a specific GPU driver path and our custom allocator. I'd call that infra+runtime. 1mo estimated to patch and 2w to add extra telemetry.
Jordan: Action items so far:
- Alex -> infra/runtime root-cause investigation + staging validation (due 2027-05-12)
- Rachel -> alerting + synthetic probe (due 2027-04-28)
- Maya -> coordinate with product to prioritize fixes in roadmap (due 2027-05-05)
- Sam -> synth doc + PM handoff (due 2027-04-27)
- Jordan -> short-term runbook + canary steps (due 2027-04-25)
Maya: Please add the owners to the PM-2027-045 ticket and add estimated impact (est monthly incidents avoided / cost saved).
Sam: will do. Also recommend we add a monthly check-in so these recurring modes are tracked; propose "failure-modes@monthly" review thread.
Rachel: Agree on monthly check-in. I’ll add acceptance criteria for alert changes and a small eval script to validate detection sensitivity.
Alex: One ask: can infra set a soft rollback policy on kernel bundles so we can revert faster during rollouts? That reduces blast radius.
Jordan: Ops can do that; need to schedule with release window team.
Maya: great. I'll summarize this thread into PM-2027-045 and ping the release and product leads. thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: Added summary + action items in the ticket and linked the three PMs. tagging @Alex @Rachel @Jordan for visibility.
Alex: Received. I’ll start the investigation tomorrow and paste initial notes in the PM ticket.
Rachel: I'll open the alert PR after tests.
Maya: Closing loop here — next check-in 2027-05-10. If anything blocks earlier, escalate in this thread.
Jordan: noted. oncall-bot, please remind us 2d before the 2027-05-10 check-in.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2027-05-08.
